jobs.title: VP, Product Management, Social
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Build the Future of Social Technology at Scale

Social is evolving fast. The technology that powers it should too.

At dentsu
, we're looking for a strategic product leader who understands the intersection of social media, marketing technology, data, and product innovation
. If you're passionate about building enterprise products, translating complex business needs into scalable solutions, and shaping the future of social activation technology, this could be the role you've been waiting for.

As our VP, Product Management, Social
, you'll define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for a portfolio of products that support audience intelligence, social activation, creator workflows, reporting, measurement, and emerging AI-powered capabilities across our media technology ecosystem.

This is a highly visible leadership role where you'll influence senior stakeholders, collaborate across business and technology teams, and drive products from concept through launch and adoption.

What You'll Do

Set the Vision

Develop and communicate a multi-year product vision for dentsu's social activation portfolio.
Identify market opportunities across social media, creator marketing, audience intelligence, AI, identity, privacy, and workflow automation.
Turn ambiguous business challenges into actionable product strategies and measurable outcomes.

Drive Product Strategy & Execution

Lead cross-functional product initiatives involving business, engineering, data, design, operations, and external partners.
Prioritize investments, features, integrations, and platform enhancements based on customer needs and business impact.
Ensure products move from vision to delivery while maintaining alignment with strategic goals.

Create Scalable Solutions

Transform one-off client solutions into repeatable, productized offerings.
Improve workflows through automation, orchestration, and platform integration.
Establish operating models that support adoption, onboarding, support, reporting, and long-term growth.

Influence & Collaborate

Partner with senior leaders across social, media, technology, data, commercial, and product organizations.
Support executive presentations, strategic client discussions, product demonstrations, and new business opportunities.
Serve as a trusted advisor on social technology, activation, audience intelligence, and product strategy.

What Makes You a Great Fit

You're a product leader who can see the big picture while remaining close enough to the details to get things done.

You likely bring:

10+ years of product management, product strategy, AdTech, MarTech, media technology, SaaS, or related experience.
Experience building product vision and strategy, not just managing features or backlogs.
Deep understanding of social media technologies, workflows, and activation platforms.
Experience leading large, cross-functional initiatives with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.
The ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business decisions and actionable plans.
Exceptional executive communication and stakeholder management skills.

Why Join dentsu?

This is an opportunity to shape a strategic growth area within one of the world's leading marketing and technology organizations.

You'll have the chance to:

Define the future of social activation products at enterprise scale.
Influence AI-enabled and next-generation workflow solutions.
Partner with industry leaders across media, technology, and data.
Solve complex challenges with real business impact.
Help create products used by practitioners and clients across the dentsu ecosystem.

Ready to Build What's Next?

We're looking for a leader who understands social technology, thrives in complexity, and can turn vision into reality. If that sounds like you, we'd love to talk.

At dentsu, we believe great work happens when we’re connected. Our way of working combines flexibility with in-person collaboration to spark ideas and strengthen our teams. Employees who live within a commutable distance of one of our hub offices, currently located in Chicago, metro Detroit, Los Angeles, and New York City, are required and expected to work from the office three days per week (two days per week for employees based in Los Angeles). Dentsu may designate other Hub offices at any time. Those who live outside a commutable range may be designated as remote, depending on the role and business needs. Regardless of your work location, we expect our employees to be flexible to meet the needs of our Company and clients, which may include attendance in an office.

The annual salary range for this position is $1360,000 - $170,000. Placement within the salary range is based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, knowledge, skills, and other factors permitted by law.

Benefits available with this position include:

Medical, vision, and dental insurance,
Life insurance,
Short-term and long-term disability insurance,
401k,
Flexible paid time off,
At least 15 paid holidays per year,
Paid sick and safe leave, and
Paid parental leave.

Dentsu also complies with applicable state and local laws regarding employee leave benefits, including, but not limited to providing time off pursuant to the Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act, in accordance with its plans and policies. For further details regarding Dentsu benefits, please visit www.dentsubenefitsplus.com.

for a global b2b2c enterprise SaaS organization. This leader will drive product strategy and oversee engineering and product teams building and scaling technology solutions across the product suite. The ideal candidate will bring a strong combination of product management and engineering leadership, with the ability to translate market and customer needs into product strategy, prioritize new initiatives, and lead large-scale technology development. This is a highly visible leadership position working closely with executive stakeholders across product, engineering, technology, and the broader business. The role will oversee 50+ employees across product and engineering and will have significant influence over the organization's product roadmap and growth strategy. This job is the equivalent of a CPTO in many other companies and while at an SVP level in this org, it will carry at Head of title.

Job Title: Senior Vice President, Product Engineering

Location:
Remote East Coast (U.S.-based, east coast hours necessary)

Responsibilities

Own the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and execution across a portfolio of B2B2C enterprise SaaS Products
Lead and develop a 60+ person product and engineering organization, including senior leaders and managers.
Balance new product development and innovation with the modernization of established, business-critical platforms.
Partner with executive leadership to evaluate new initiatives, prioritize investment, and translate business goals into product and technology strategy.
Drive modernization of legacy technology while maintaining production stability, customer commitments, and revenue continuity.
Establish stronger collaboration across product, engineering, technology, and business stakeholders to improve delivery and product outcomes.

Required Skills & Experience

15+ years of progressive experience across product management, software engineering, technology, or a combination of the two, including significant experience leading at the Director/VP level.
early career development in software engineering or relative engineering function across technology products
Proven experience leading large, multidisciplinary organizations of 50+ employees across product management, engineering, and/or technology, with responsibility for organizational structure, hiring, performance, and leadership development.
Strong technical foundation in software engineering and product development, with enough depth to credibly partner with senior architects and engineering leaders on architecture, APIs, integrations, cloud platforms, technical debt, and modernization strategy.
Demonstrated success owning the strategy and evolution of large-scale, revenue-generating technology products, including responsibility for product vision, roadmap, prioritization, investment decisions, and measurable business outcomes.
Proven experience modernizing mature or legacy platforms without disrupting an existing production business. Must understand how to balance technical debt, modernization, new feature development, customer commitments, and revenue continuity.
Experience taking an established product through a meaningful technology or product transformation, while simultaneously introducing new capabilities, improving the customer experience, and establishing a longer-term platform strategy.
Executive-level experience partnering with a Managing Director, GM, CEO, CTO, CIO, or equivalent business leadership, with the ability to influence strategy, challenge assumptions, and make difficult prioritization and investment decisions.
Demonstrated ability to operate at both the strategic and technical level: setting a multi-year product vision while understanding the engineering realities required to execute it.
Strong change leadership skills and the ability to bring new product thinking, modern development practices, and innovative approaches into an established organization without losing operational discipline.
Exceptional executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with the presence and judgment to lead through ambiguity, competing priorities, and significant organizational change.

Compensation

$300,000 - 360,000 Base Salary + 25% Annual Bonus + Equity Package + Comprehensive benefits package

Remote opportunity for candidates based in the United States and can work EST Hours
Must be authorized to work in the United States — no visa sponsorship available

7+ years of experience in a customer-facing, technology-related business role as a product manager.

jobs.title: Director of Product Marketing
jobs.description:
Join the team leading the next evolution of virtual care.

At Teladoc Health, you are empowered to bring your true self to work while helping millions of people live their healthiest lives.

Here you will be part of a high-performance culture where colleagues embrace challenges, drive transformative solutions, and create opportunities for growth. Together, we’re transforming how better health happens.

Summary Of Position

The Director, B2B Product Marketing leads strategy and commercialization for Teladoc Health’s enterprise solutions, translating product capabilities, clinical outcomes, buyer needs, and market dynamics into differentiated positioning and go-to-market strategies.

This leader connects Product, Marketing, Sales, Clinical, Client Management, and other client-facing teams to ensure solutions are clearly positioned, commercially ready, and tied to member and business outcomes.

Reporting to the Head of Product Marketing, this role advances B2B priorities within the broader B2B2C strategy. Success requires simplifying complexity, influencing senior stakeholders, and turning insight into actionable narratives, plans, and tools.

Key Responsibilities

B2B positioning and narrative: Own positioning, value propositions, and messaging for priority enterprise solutions, segments, and buyers. Translate complex capabilities into clear customer value and align messaging across customer-facing teams.
Core sales assets and buyer enablement: Create scalable pitch decks, sell sheets, messaging guides, FAQs, competitive positioning, proof points, and training that support acquisition, retention, and expansion. Partner with B2B Marketing, Content, and Creative on broader execution.
Go-to-market and launches: Lead B2B go-to-market strategy and commercial readiness for priority offerings. Define audiences, buyer needs, positioning, readiness requirements, and success measures; partner with Product on commercialization and B2B Marketing on activation.
Customer adoption and value: Develop value stories, use cases, and proof points across consideration, adoption, renewal, and expansion. Connect enterprise value to member awareness, utilization, outcomes, and buyer ROI.
Cross-functional leadership: Lead complex initiatives through influence, clarify roles and decisions, and serve as the Product Marketing partner for assigned solutions. Align priorities, resources, launches, and market strategy with the broader portfolio.

What Success Looks Like

Clear, differentiated positioning aligned to the broader portfolio.
Scalable sales assets that strengthen enterprise buyer conversations.
Faster launches with clear readiness, ownership, and measurable outcomes.
Insights that shape product, commercialization, and growth decisions.
Stronger links between buyer value, member outcomes, and acquisition, renewal, and expansion.
Product Marketing recognized as the bridge between product strategy, customer needs, growth, and member value.

Qualifications

8+ years in marketing, including significant B2B product marketing, go-to-market strategy, commercialization, or solution marketing experience.
Enterprise buyer fluency, with demonstrated experience marketing complex products or solutions and navigating multi-stakeholder buying processes.
Proven ability to develop differentiated positioning, value propositions, messaging frameworks, and core commercial enablement assets.
Track record leading product launches and commercial readiness across complex, cross-functional organizations.
Experience using market research, voice-of-customer inputs, and competitive intelligence to shape positioning, roadmap inputs, and commercialization strategy.
Strategic and hands-on leader who can connect narrative, enablement, launch readiness, customer value, and measurement to business outcomes.
Healthcare, digital health, benefits, insurance, technology, or other regulated, multi-stakeholder industry experience preferred.
Excellent storytelling, executive communication, stakeholder management, influence, and decision-framing skills.
Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred.
Potential of <10% travel required.

The base salary range for this position is $170,000 - $185,000. In addition to a base salary, this position is eligible for a performance bonus and benefits (subject to eligibility requirements) listed here: Teladoc Health Benefits 2026. Total compensation is based on several factors including, but not limited to, type of position, location, education level, work experience, and certifications. This information is applicable for all full-time positions.

We follow a Flexible Vacation Policy, intended for rest, relaxation, and personal time. All time off must be approved by your manager prior to use. You will also receive 80 hours of Paid Sick, Safe, and Caregiver Leave annually. This applies to full-time positions only. If you are applying for a part-time role, your recruiter can provide additional details.

As part of our hiring process, we verify identity and credentials, conduct interviews (live or video), and screen for fraud or misrepresentation. Applicants who falsify information will be disqualified.

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

This is a defining opportunity for a Senior Product Manager
to build the platform that brings every new Samsara product to market.

You will build the monetization primitives every product team depends on, and you will shape what Samsara charges for and how it bundles. Samsara offers a diverse array of products and as we expand to new categories and markets, we’ll need a monetization platform that supports how we scale to meet these needs.

Define how Samsara prices new AI products, including agent work, MCP and API access, and products billed on the results they produce.
